wv_tractor_trailer_boulder.blurb: A single large trailer-shaped sandstone boulder tucked into the Greenbrier Boulders group, among the bouldering clusters off the forest road at Coopers Rock in northern West Virginia. Ten problems are recorded, and the grade spread leans hard: a pair of easy-to-moderate lines (a V0 and a V3) sit beside a run of V8 to V12 problems, so this is more a destination for strong boulderers than for beginners. The stone is described as high quality, with a slabby side. The way in climbs uphill past neighbouring boulders and finishes through some briers.
wv_tractor_trailer_boulder.approach: Start from the Caterpillar Boulder and follow the trail uphill, passing the Pup Trailer Boulder, then a mossy slab. Bear right through the briers to reach the big boulder shaped like a trailer.
